title: Lysol
description: Lysol is a mod for Minecraft compatible with versions 1.21.8 to 1.21.11 that adds new content to explore.
body:
_**Lysol**_ is a mod for Minecraft compatible with versions **1.21.8 to 1.21.11** that adds new content to explore.

The mod introduces a **new purple wood(_ishol_) biome**, a mysterious environment filled with unique resources. In this biome, players can encounter a **new mob called KLysol**. When defeated, this mob drops an **Acorn Block**, a special resource used in the mod.

Lysol also adds a new ore called **Acorn**, which can be used to craft new tools and armor. These items give players new ways to progress and survive while exploring the biome.

With new mobs, new resources, and a brand-new biome, Lysol brings a fresh adventure to players who want to discover something different in their Minecraft world.
